newsitem.title: GERMANY: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest -July 31.
newsitem.headline: Reuters German Advertising & Media Digest -July 31.

text.p: News from Reuters and the German press on Advertising, Marketing, Media, the Internet, Brand-name Products and Consumer Trends

FRANKFURT - Young & Rubicam (Y&R) ad agency confirms that Ingo Krauss, the chairman and chief executive of its German unit, is stepping down after nearly 30 years with the company. Tiemen Bosma, previously of Y&R's Dutch unit, will take over Krauss's responsibilities effective next week. (Reuter)

FRANKFURT - Ad agency Tostmann & Wulfes shifts top management. After Thomas Wulfes, chief executive and co-owner decided to leave the agency, Marga Bonato and Kai Kraushaar will be promoted to replace him effective August 1, the Frankfurt-based agency says. (Reuter)
MUNICH - Top German soccer team FC Bayern Muenchen has not extended its contract with marketing agency Ufa and replaced it with a new partnership with Eigenregie. (Sport Informationsdienst)

FRANKFURT - Kraft Jacobs Suchard awards its German media account to two agencies: Media Consult in Frankfurt and Media Direction in Duesseldorf. The agencies will design the company's television planning and scheduling. (Horizont)

FRANKFURT - German legislation concerning the Internet that takes effect on Friday will not create new limits on the development of advertising or shopping in cyberspace, marketing experts say. The law sets new standards for child protection on the Internet and defines which activities require regulation and which can be operated without any formal licence or regulatory oversight. (Reuter)

MUNICH - Private German TV stations have lost nearly 4.7 billion marks ($2.6 billion) since 1984, consulting firm HMR says, based on information provided by the advertising industry, trade publication Horizont and news magazine Der Speigel. (Sueddeutsche Zeitung)
